parole.significato: forms the augmentative of nouns, often pejorative
the left side, part, half or direction
parole.testo: Borrowed from Basque ezkerra, absolutive singular form of ezker (“left”). Cognate with Catalan esquerra and Spanish izquierda. Displaced sestra.

parole.motivo_incerta: Of uncertain origin; Possibly; either; modello unc/uncertain
parole.testo: From Dutch bakeljauw, bakkeljauw, of uncertain origin. Possibly from Late Latin baccalaureus, baculum (“stick, staff”), referring to the way cod were split and dried on wooden sticks.
